title: Chatpata Bhindi Aloo | Crispy Okra Stir Fry
description:
Crispy, spicy okra and potato stir-fry. Serves 3-4.

INGREDIENTS
250 g okra (bhindi)
2 small onions
2 tbsp mustard oil
1/2 tsp cumin seeds
Salt, to taste

METHOD
1. Wash the okra, dry it well and cut into thick dice.
2. Heat the oil in a kadhai, add the cumin seeds and the sliced onions and cook until translucent.
3. Add the okra and cook covered on low heat until tender. Season with salt and serve.
